posts.text:
Based on a forensic report I’ve seen, Eric Swalwell could be facing jail soon. He did the right thing by resigning but his troubles aren’t over yet.

Video
We have successfully drained part of the swamp this week with the resignation of two very corrupt members of Congress. Thank you for your attention to this matter.

This was the right thing to do.


Rep. Tony Gonzales (@RepTonyGonzales)

There is a season for everything and God has a plan for us all. When Congress returns tomorrow, I will file my retirement from office. It has been my privilege to serve the great people of Texas.



— https://nitter.net/RepTonyGonzales/status/2043819211865129159#m

This was the right thing to do.


Reese Gorman (@reesejgorman)

NEWS: Tony Gonzales tells me he plans to retire from Congress TOMORROW.

Official announcement coming soon he says



— https://nitter.net/reesejgorman/status/2043816908554744274#m

Eric Swalwell has resigned. Eric, you did the right thing by resigning. However, don’t you dare say there weren’t grounds for your expulsion because there absolutely were. He made the correct decision, but there still needs to be a full-fledged criminal investigation. Based on what I’m hearing, he may go to jail.

Yes. I am. It is time to END the corruption in congress!

nytimes.com/2026/04/13/us/po…

I am being told there will be more disgusting stuff coming out on Swallwell in the next 24 hours. For the members of Congress who are concerned about optics on expelling Swalwell, I think after the information drops you will be thinking otherwise. 

Eric, why dont you tell us a little about who was filming the video of the female sex worker.

You broke House rules and are a predator. You have 24 hours to announce you are resigning. Both you and Tony are a disgrace.


Eric Swalwell (@ericswalwell)

I am suspending my campaign for Governor.  

To my family, staff, friends, and supporters, I am deeply sorry for mistakes in judgment I’ve made in my past. 

I will fight the serious, false allegations that have been made — but that’s my fight, not a campaign’s.



— https://nitter.net/ericswalwell/status/2043488502327972096#m

I will be supporting this resolution!


Rep. Teresa Leger Fernández (@RepTeresaLF)

As I’ve said, Gonzales and Swalwell are not fit to serve in Congress given their sexual transgressions against women who work for them. They should resign or be expelled.

There’s already been a resolution announced to expel Swalwell that I will support. I will introduce a resolution to expel Rep. Gonzales.



— https://nitter.net/RepTeresaLF/status/2043488894709035515#m

I will be inquiring in the morning with the house parliamentarian to see if I can pair my motion to expel Eric Swalwell with Rep Tony Gonzalez. Both NEED to go.


Rep. Anna Paulina Luna (@RepLuna)

I am filing a motion to expel Eric Swalwell from Congress.



— https://nitter.net/RepLuna/status/2042963674462064894#m

Well said. Expel them both. Enough is enough.


Rep. Jared Huffman (@JaredHuffman)

I've seen enough. With his nuanced statement aimed at defending likely criminal charges, Swalwell all but admits a per se abuse of power under House ethics rules: sex with a subordinate. He must now drop out of the Governor's race and resign from Congress.  Rep. Tony Gonzales, who admitted to the same violation, should also resign.  If they don't, I will support voting to expel both of them. politico.com/news/202
